SQLQueries.GetMonthlyAttendanceReport: SELECT v.Id, v.EmployeeNumber, v.EmployeeName, v.CalendarDate, v.PunchIn, v.PunchOut, v.WorkingDuration, v.Month, v.Source, v.TenantId AS OrganisationId, v.SystemUserId FROM [dbo].[VwTimsheetPageData] v INNER JOIN Employee e ON v.EmployeeNumber = e.EmployeeNumber WHERE v.CalendarDate >= @DateFrom AND v.CalendarDate <= @DateTo AND (@BranchId IS NULL OR e.BranchId = @BranchId) AND (@OrganisationId IS NULL OR v.TenantId = @OrganisationId) AND (@EmployeeId IS NULL OR e.Id = @EmployeeId) AND (@DepartmentId IS NULL OR e.DepartmentId = @DepartmentId) AND v.Source='Punch' ORDER BY v.CalendarDate, v.EmployeeNumber

SQLQueries.DeactivateEmployee: UPDATE Employee SET IsEmployeeActive = 0 WHERE Id = @Id
SQLQueries.GetPaySlipsByEmployeeId: SELECT Id, PayrollId, EmployeeId, BankAccountNumber, BankName, IFSCCode, BankBranchName, BasicSalary, TotalIncome, TotalDeduction, TakeHomePay, TenantId, Gross, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, Email, DateOfBirth, TaxNumber, ESINo, PFNo, UANNo, IsPerDayWagesEmployee, DateOfJoining, PerDayOverTimeWages, PayrollMonth, PayrollYear, DaysPayable, OverTimeDays, PresentDays, SalarySlab, PerDayWages, OvertimeSalary, SalaryEarned, TenantName, Currency, GenderName, DesignationName, BranchName, PayrollMonthName, FinancialYearStart, LossPayDays, Logo FROM [dbo].[vwPayrollDetailPrint] WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND (@Year IS NULL OR PayrollYear = @Year) AND (@Month IS NULL OR PayrollMonth = @Month) ORDER BY PayrollYear DESC, PayrollMonth DESC
SQLQueries.GetPaySlipById: SELECT Id, PayrollId, EmployeeId, BankAccountNumber, BankName, IFSCCode, BankBranchName, BasicSalary, TotalIncome, TotalDeduction, TakeHomePay, TenantId, Gross, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, Email, DateOfBirth, TaxNumber, ESINo, PFNo, UANNo, IsPerDayWagesEmployee, DateOfJoining, PerDayOverTimeWages, PayrollMonth, PayrollYear, DaysPayable, OverTimeDays, PresentDays, SalarySlab, PerDayWages, OvertimeSalary, SalaryEarned, TenantName, Currency, GenderName, DesignationName, BranchName, PayrollMonthName, FinancialYearStart, LossPayDays, Logo FROM [dbo].[vwPayrollDetailPrint] WHERE Id = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetPaySlipByEmployeeMonthYear: SELECT Id, PayrollId, EmployeeId, BankAccountNumber, BankName, IFSCCode, BankBranchName, BasicSalary, TotalIncome, TotalDeduction, TakeHomePay, TenantId, Gross, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, Email, DateOfBirth, TaxNumber, ESINo, PFNo, UANNo, IsPerDayWagesEmployee, DateOfJoining, PerDayOverTimeWages, PayrollMonth, PayrollYear, DaysPayable, OverTimeDays, PresentDays, SalarySlab, PerDayWages, OvertimeSalary, SalaryEarned, TenantName, Currency, GenderName, DesignationName, BranchName, PayrollMonthName, FinancialYearStart, LossPayDays, Logo FROM [dbo].[vwPayrollDetailPrint] WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND PayrollMonth = @Month AND PayrollYear = @Year
SQLQueries.GetPaySlipFilePath: SELECT PaySlipFilePath FROM PaySlip WHERE Id = @Id
SQLQueries.GetEmployeeProvidentFundSummary: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.DeductionCode = 'ProvidentFundEmployee' THEN pdd.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS MyShare, SUM(CASE WHEN d.DeductionCode = 'ProvidentFundCompany' THEN pdd.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS EmployerShare FROM PayrollDetailDeduction pdd INNER JOIN PayrollDetail pd ON pd.Id = pdd.PayrollDetailId INNER JOIN Deduction d ON d.Id = pdd.DeductionId WHERE pd.EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND pd.TenantId = @TenantId AND d.IsActive = 1 AND d.DeductionCode IN ('ProvidentFundEmployee','ProvidentFundCompany')
SQLQueries.GetMonthlyPayrollSummary: SELECT pd.BasicSalary, pd.Gross, pd.TotalIncome, pd.TotalDeduction, pd.TakeHomePay FROM PayrollDetail pd INNER JOIN Payroll p ON p.Id = pd.PayrollId WHERE pd.EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND pd.TenantId = @TenantId AND p.PayrollMonth = @Month AND p.PayrollYear = @Year
SQLQueries.GetMonthlyPayrollIncomes: SELECT i.Name, pdi.Amount FROM PayrollDetailIncome pdi INNER JOIN Income i ON i.Id = pdi.IncomeId INNER JOIN PayrollDetail pd ON pd.Id = pdi.PayrollDetailId INNER JOIN Payroll p ON p.Id = pd.PayrollId WHERE pd.EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND pd.TenantId = @TenantId AND p.PayrollMonth = @Month AND p.PayrollYear = @Year
SQLQueries.GetMonthlyPayrollDeductions: SELECT d.Name, d.DeductionCode, pdd.Amount FROM PayrollDetailDeduction pdd INNER JOIN Deduction d ON d.Id = pdd.DeductionId INNER JOIN PayrollDetail pd ON pd.Id = pdd.PayrollDetailId INNER JOIN Payroll p ON p.Id = pd.PayrollId WHERE pd.EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND pd.TenantId = @TenantId AND p.PayrollMonth = @Month AND p.PayrollYear = @Year
SQLQueries.GetPaySlipIncomes: SELECT i.Name AS Description, pdi.Amount FROM PayrollDetailIncome pdi INNER JOIN Income i ON i.Id = pdi.IncomeId WHERE pdi.PayrollDetailId = @PaySlipId
SQLQueries.GetPaySlipDeductions: SELECT d.Name AS Description, d.DeductionCode, pdd.Amount FROM PayrollDetailDeduction pdd INNER JOIN Deduction d ON d.Id = pdd.DeductionId WHERE pdd.PayrollDetailId = @PaySlipId
SQLQueries.GetEmployeeIdAndTenantByUserId: SELECT Id, TenantId FROM Employee WHERE SystemUserId = @UserId
SQLQueries.UpdatePassword: UPDATE Users SET PasswordHash = @PasswordHash, PasswordSalt = @PasswordSalt WHERE UserId = @UserId
SQLQueries.GetAttendanceByCalendar: SELECT v.Id, v.EmployeeNumber, v.EmployeeName, v.CalendarDate, v.PunchIn, v.PunchOut, v.WorkingDuration, v.Month, v.Source, v.TenantId AS OrganisationId, v.SystemUserId FROM [dbo].[VwTimsheetPageData] v INNER JOIN Employee e ON v.EmployeeNumber = e.EmployeeNumber WHERE e.Id = @EmployeeId AND v.CalendarDate >= @DateFrom AND v.CalendarDate <= @DateTo AND v.Source='Punch' ORDER BY v.CalendarDate
SQLQueries.InsertEvent: INSERT INTO Events (UserId, EventTypeId, EventData, State, Status, TenantId, InsertDate, InsertUserId, created_at) VALUES (@UserId, @EventTypeId, @EventData, @State, @Status, @TenantId, GETDATE(), @InsertUserId, GETDATE()); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT);
SQLQueries.GetEventById: SELECT EventId AS Id, UserId, EventTypeId, EventData, State, Status, TenantId, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId FROM Events WHERE EventId = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.UpdateEventStatus: UPDATE Events SET State = @State, Status = @Status, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserId = @UpdateUserId WHERE EventId = @EventId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetEventTypeIdByName: SELECT EventTypeId FROM EventTypes WHERE EventName = @EventName AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1
SQLQueries.GetEventTypeById: SELECT EventTypeId AS Id, EventName, Description, TenantId, IsActive FROM EventTypes WHERE EventTypeId = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.IsEventTypeActive: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM EventTypes WHERE EventTypeId = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)
SQLQueries.GetFirstApprovalLevelName: SELECT TOP 1 StageName FROM ApprovalStage WHERE EventTypeId = @EventTypeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1 ORDER BY Sequence ASC
SQLQueries.GetApprovalStageByLevelName: SELECT StageId AS Id, EventTypeId, StageName AS LevelName, WorkRoleId, UserId AS ExplicitUserIds, Sequence AS StageOrder, TenantId, IsActive FROM ApprovalStage WHERE EventTypeId = @EventTypeId AND StageName = @LevelName AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1
SQLQueries.IsApprovalStageActive: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ApprovalStage WHERE StageId = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)
SQLQueries.GetApproversByWorkRole: SELECT u.UserId, u.Email, e.Name, e.Id AS EmployeeId FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Employee e ON u.UserId = e.SystemUserId WHERE u.TenantId = @TenantId AND u.IsActive = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(u.WorkRoleId, ',') AS s WHERE TRY_CAST(s.value AS INT) = @WorkRoleId)
SQLQueries.GetApproversByUserIds: SELECT u.UserId, u.Email, e.Name, e.Id AS EmployeeId FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Employee e ON u.UserId = e.SystemUserId WHERE u.UserId IN (@UserIds) AND u.TenantId = @TenantId AND u.IsActive = 1
SQLQueries.GetUserIdByEmployeeId: SELECT SystemUserId FROM Employee WHERE Id = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetEmployeeNamesByUserIds: SELECT e.Name FROM Employee e INNER JOIN Users u ON e.SystemUserId = u.UserId WHERE u.UserId IN (@UserIds) AND e.TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.InsertApproval: INSERT INTO Approvals (EventId, StageId, ApproverId, Action, TenantId, InsertDate, InsertUserId) VALUES (@EventId, @StageId, @ApproverId, @Action, @TenantId, GETDATE(), @InsertUserId); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT);
SQLQueries.UpdateApprovalStatus: UPDATE Approvals SET Action = @Action, comments = @Comments, ActionDate = @ActionDate, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserId = @UpdateUserId WHERE ApprovalId = @Id
SQLQueries.GetApprovalsByEventId: SELECT ApprovalId AS Id, EventId, StageId AS ApprovalStageId, ApproverId, Action AS ApprovalStatus, comments AS Comments, ActionDate AS ApprovalDate, TenantId, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId FROM Approvals WHERE EventId = @EventId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.InsertScreenNotification: INSERT INTO ScreenNotification (TenantId, UserId, EventId, Title, Message, IsRead, IsActive, status, InsertDate, InsertUserId) VALUES (@TenantId, @UserId, @EventId, @Title, @Message, @IsRead, @IsActive, 'Unread', GETDATE(), @InsertUserId); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT);
SQLQueries.InsertEmailNotification: INSERT INTO EmailNotification (ToEmail, Subject, Body, IsSent, TenantId, InsertDate, InsertUserId) VALUES (@ToEmail, @Subject, @Body, 0, @TenantId, GETDATE(), @InsertUserId); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT);
SQLQueries.GetEmailTemplate: SELECT Id, EventName, ActionType, Subject, Body, TenantId, IsActive FROM EmailTemplate WHERE EventName = @EventName AND ActionType = @ActionType AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1
SQLQueries.GetNotificationTemplate: SELECT Id, TemplateName, Title, Body, Parameter, Format, TemplateType, ActionType, TenantId, IsActive FROM Template WHERE TemplateName = @TemplateName AND TemplateType = @TemplateType AND ActionType = @ActionType AND TenantId = @TenantId AND IsActive = 1
SQLQueries.GetTenantName: SELECT TenantName FROM Tenant WHERE TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetAttendanceReportsByOrganisation: SELECT v.Id, v.EmployeeNumber, v.EmployeeName, v.CalendarDate, v.PunchIn, v.PunchOut, v.WorkingDuration, v.Month, v.Source, v.TenantId AS OrganisationId, v.SystemUserId FROM [dbo].[VwTimsheetPageData] v WHERE v.TenantId = @OrganisationId AND v.CalendarDate >= @DateFrom AND v.CalendarDate <= @DateTo AND v.Source='Punch' ORDER BY v.CalendarDate, v.EmployeeNumber
SQLQueries.CreateHoliday: INSERT INTO Holiday (Name, Date, Description, TenantId, InsertDate, InsertUserId) VALUES (@Name, @Date, @Description, @TenantId, GETDATE(), @InsertUserId); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT);
SQLQueries.GetHolidayById: SELECT Id, Name, Date, Description, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, TenantId FROM Holiday WHERE Id = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetAllHolidays: SELECT Id, Name, Date, Description, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, TenantId FROM Holiday WHERE TenantId = @TenantId ORDER BY Date ASC
SQLQueries.GetHolidaysWithFilters: SELECT Id, Name, Date, Description, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, TenantId FROM Holiday WHERE TenantId = @TenantId AND (@Year IS NULL OR YEAR(Date) = @Year) ORDER BY Date ASC
SQLQueries.UpdateHoliday: UPDATE Holiday SET Name = @Name, Date = @Date, Description = @Description, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserId = @UpdateUserId WHERE Id = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.HardDeleteHoliday: DELETE FROM Holiday WHERE Id = @Id AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetEventDataAndName: SELECT e.EventData, et.EventName FROM Events e INNER JOIN EventTypes et ON e.EventTypeId = et.EventTypeId WHERE e.EventId = @EventId AND e.TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetLeaveRequestDates: SELECT FromDate, ToDate FROM LeaveRequest WHERE Id = @LeaveRequestId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetOvertimeDetails: SELECT OvertimeDate, Duration FROM Overtime WHERE Id = @OvertimeId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetReimbursementDetails: SELECT TransactionDate, TotalAmount FROM Reimbursement WHERE Id = @ReimbursementId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetResignationDetails: SELECT ResignationDate, Number FROM Resignation WHERE Id = @ResignationId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetPayrollMonthYear: SELECT PayrollMonth, PayrollYear FROM Payroll WHERE Id = @PayrollId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.UpdatePayrollApprovalStatus: UPDATE Payroll SET IsPayrollApproved = @IsApproved WHERE Id = @PayrollId AND TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetWorkingHoursByTenantId: SELECT TOP 1 WorkingHours FROM TenantConfiguration WHERE TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.GetTenantDayOffIds: SELECT DISTINCT DayOffId FROM TenantConfiguredDayOffDays WHERE TenantConfigurationId IN (SELECT TenantConfigurationId FROM TenantConfiguration WHERE TenantId = @TenantId)
SQLQueries.GetActualHoursByEmployeeAndDateRange: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Duration), 0) AS TotalHours FROM Punch WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND PunchDate >= @FromDate AND PunchDate <= @ToDate AND PunchOut IS NOT NULL
SQLQueries.AttendanceOverview_GetWorkingHours: SELECT TOP 1 WorkingHours FROM TenantConfiguration WHERE TenantId = @TenantId
SQLQueries.AttendanceOverview_GetDayOffs: SELECT DISTINCT DayOffId FROM TenantConfiguredDayOffDays WHERE TenantConfigurationId IN (SELECT TenantConfigurationId FROM TenantConfiguration WHERE TenantId = @TenantId)
SQLQueries.AttendanceOverview_GetActualHours: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Duration), 0) AS TotalHours FROM Punch WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND PunchDate >= @FromDate AND PunchDate <= @ToDate AND PunchOut IS NOT NULL
SQLQueries.GetDisputeCategories: SELECT Id, CategoryName, IsActive, CreatedOn FROM DisputeCategory WHERE IsActive = 1 ORDER BY CategoryName
SQLQueries.GetExistingDispute: SELECT Id, EmployeeId, DisputeCategoryId, DisputeDate, Description, Status, CreatedOn FROM EmployeeDispute WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND DisputeDate = @DisputeDate
SQLQueries.InsertDispute: INSERT INTO EmployeeDispute (EmployeeId, DisputeCategoryId, DisputeDate, Description, Status, CreatedOn) VALUES (@EmployeeId, @DisputeCategoryId, @DisputeDate, @Description, @Status, @CreatedOn); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT)
